_: Auth area: sign in, registration, password recovery, e-mail confirmation, root recovery, account security and the company security audit page.
_dynamic: SecurityCategory.*, SecurityOutcome.*, SecurityActorKind.*, SecurityIntegrity.* and SecurityDirection.* are resolved from API string values on the Security page (unknown values fall back to the raw value).
